maxTokens.label: Maximum output tokens
maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate at once.

contextTokens.label: Context length
contextTokens.description: Total number of tokens the model can reference at once.

minimum12b.label: 12B minimum
minimum12b.description: For about 8 GB of VRAM. Prioritizes compatibility and light operation.

economy26b.label: 26B economy
economy26b.description: For about 16 GB of VRAM. Keeps 1024 image tokens and runs the 26B model more safely.

full31b.label: 31B full
full31b.description: For ample VRAM. Uses the 31B model and DFlash with quality as the priority.

huggingface.label: Hugging Face
huggingface.description: Download the model automatically from a Hugging Face repository.

local.label: Local files
local.description: Use GGUF and mmproj files you provide.

gemma.label: Local Gemma
gemma.description: Run a Gemma model directly on this PC.

codex.label: Codex
codex.description: Translate through a Codex OAuth endpoint.

high.label: High
high.description: Uses more reasoning for better quality.

xhigh.label: Very high
xhigh.description: Uses extra reasoning for complex translations.

max.label: Maximum
max.description: Uses the highest standard reasoning level supported by the model.

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.description: Requests the model's highest supported reasoning level.

cuda.label: NVIDIA CUDA
cuda.description: Run Paddle OCR on an NVIDIA GPU.

rocm.label: AMD ROCm
rocm.description: Use the experimental OCR engine for AMD GPUs.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.description: Run OCR on the CPU without a GPU.

rtx50.label: RTX 50
rtx50.description: CUDA runtime tuned for RTX 50-series GPUs.

cuda.label: NVIDIA CUDA
cuda.description: The fastest native Flux runtime on RTX GPUs.

zluda.label: AMD ZLUDA
zluda.description: Runs Flux through ZLUDA on AMD GPUs. Requires the AMD HIP SDK.

cpu.label: CPU
cpu.description: A slow CPU compatibility mode for systems without a matching GPU runtime.

aot.label: AOT minimum
aot.description: The lightest Koharu AOT inpainting model.

lama.label: LaMa economy
lama.description: A lightweight, fast LaMa model specialized for manga.

flux.label: Flux full
flux.description: The default quality-first Flux inpainting model.

validation.oauthPort: The openai-oauth port must be an integer from 1 to 65535.
validation.apiBaseUrl: The API base URL must be an HTTP or HTTPS URL.
validation.maxTokens: Maximum output tokens must be an integer from {{min}} to {{max}}.
validation.contextTokens: Context length must be an integer of at least {{min}}.
validation.apiNumberRange: The API number setting must be from {{min}} to {{max}}.
validation.apiIntegerRange: The API integer setting must be an integer from {{min}} to {{max}}.
validation.apiJsonInvalid: The API JSON setting must be a valid JSON object.
validation.apiJsonObject: The API JSON setting must be an object.
validation.customHeaderBlocked: The {{name}} header cannot be overridden in Custom headers.
validation.customHeaderValue: Custom header values may only be strings, numbers, or booleans.
